Weight, Shape & Skin

Slimming & Body Contouring in Bangalore

Doctor-supervised weight management, non-surgical body contouring and surgical planning in Whitefield, Bangalore. Every plan starts with a medical assessment, so the approach fits your health and goals.

Call the Clinic

Three Different Kinds of Care, One Assessment

Overall weight, localised fat and loose skin are different concerns and need different care. Medical weight management looks at health, habits and, where suitable, prescription medicines under supervision. Non-surgical contouring treats selected areas in people near a stable weight. Surgery is considered when skin or tissue change is beyond what other care can do.

Your consultation starts with your health history, medicines, past efforts and goals. Weight, pregnancy, eating concerns and other health conditions all affect what is suitable, so no treatment is chosen before that assessment.

  • 01

    Medical assessment first

    History, examination and, where useful, body-composition analysis before any plan.

  • 02

    Weight management

    Doctor-supervised programmes; prescription medicines only where clinically suitable.

  • 03

    Non-surgical contouring

    For selected areas of localised fat, cellulite or skin laxity, not overall weight.

  • 04

    Surgical planning

    Liposuction or skin-removal surgery assessed by a plastic surgeon when appropriate.

  • 05

    Follow-up

    Progress is reviewed over time; change is gradual and differs from person to person.

Slimming & Body Contouring Treatments

Explore each treatment, or book a consultation and let the assessment point you to the right one.

Doctor-Supervised Weight Management & GLP-1

Medical support for overall weight, starting with your health rather than a medicine.

  • GLP-1 Weight Loss Program

    Treatment should begin with a medical assessment, not a medicine chosen from an advertisement.

    Explore: GLP-1 Weight Loss Program

  • Mounjaro Weight Loss Consultation

    Mounjaro is a prescription medicine, so a weight-loss enquiry should begin with a clinician reviewing the person, not with a pre-set dose or package.

    Explore: Mounjaro Weight Loss Consultation

  • Ozempic Weight Loss Consultation

    Ozempic is a prescription medicine, not a routine slimming product. The consultation reviews your health history, current medicines, past weight-management efforts and goals before discussing whether semaglutide or another option fits.

    Explore: Ozempic Weight Loss Consultation

  • Medical Weight Loss Treatment

    Medical weight loss at NeoSculpt6 is a structured, doctor-supervised approach for people who need more than a short-term diet plan.

    Explore: Medical Weight Loss Treatment

  • Obesity Treatment

    Obesity is a chronic health concern that can be influenced by biology, lifestyle, medicines, sleep, stress and other medical factors.

    Explore: Obesity Treatment

  • Personalized Diet & Lifestyle Management

    Sustainable weight management works best with routines that fit everyday life. Guidance is built around current eating, activity, work, sleep, health history and realistic goals, then refined through follow-up.

    Explore: Personalized Diet & Lifestyle Management

  • Body Composition Analysis

    Body composition analysis puts body weight in context by examining the components that contribute to it.

    Explore: Body Composition Analysis

Fat Reduction & Non-Surgical Contouring

For selected areas of localised fat in people near a stable weight.

  • Body Contouring

    Body contouring improves shape, proportion and selected areas, not obesity. NeoSculpt6 first identifies whether a concern is localised fat, skin laxity, tissue quality or a mix, then chooses a matching treatment pathway.

    Explore: Body Contouring

  • Cryolipolysis Treatment

    Cryolipolysis is a non-surgical body-contouring method for selected localised fat pockets.

    Explore: Cryolipolysis Treatment

  • Lipolaser Treatment

    Lipolaser is used for selected localised fat concerns, but the right approach depends on the tissue and area.

    Explore: Lipolaser Treatment

  • LipoZero Treatment

    LipoZero is offered at NeoSculpt6 for selected localised body-contour concerns. Because branded systems vary, the clinic confirms the exact LipoZero method during consultation and plans treatment around the target area, tissue and realistic goals.

    Explore: LipoZero Treatment

  • Inch Loss Treatment

    Inch-loss treatment is localised body-contouring care, not a promise of overall weight reduction.

    Explore: Inch Loss Treatment

  • Belly & Tummy Fat Reduction

    NeoSculpt6 assesses subcutaneous fat, skin laxity, abdominal contour and overall health before recommending treatment.

    Explore: Belly & Tummy Fat Reduction

  • Arm Fat Reduction

    Upper-arm fullness can come from localised fat, loose skin, or both. NeoSculpt6 tells these apart before treatment, since removing fat alone can be the wrong choice when laxity is the main concern.

    Explore: Arm Fat Reduction

  • Thigh Fat Reduction

    Thigh contour concerns can involve the inner thigh, outer thigh or both, and may coexist with cellulite or skin laxity.

    Explore: Thigh Fat Reduction

  • Hip Fat Reduction

    Hip fullness is judged alongside the waist, flanks and thighs, since changing one area shifts overall proportion.

    Explore: Hip Fat Reduction

  • Love Handle Reduction

    Love handles are localised fat deposits around the flanks that can break up the waistline even when weight is stable.

    Explore: Love Handle Reduction

  • Upper Back Fat Reduction

    Upper-back fullness can form visible rolls around the bra line or shoulder-blade region and may remain despite stable weight.

    Explore: Upper Back Fat Reduction

  • Double Chin Fat Reduction

    A double chin may stem from submental fat, skin laxity, jawline structure or a mix. NeoSculpt6 examines the area in profile and from the front to decide whether fat reduction, tightening or another approach fits best.

    Explore: Double Chin Fat Reduction

Liposuction & Surgical Contouring

Surgical options, planned by our plastic surgeon, on the Cosmetic Surgery pages.

  • Liposuction Surgery

    Liposuction removes chosen pockets of subcutaneous fat through small cannulas to refine body shape.

    Explore: Liposuction Surgery

  • Tummy Tuck Surgery (Abdominoplasty)

    An abdominoplasty removes selected excess abdominal skin and fat and can tighten lax or separated muscles when needed.

    Explore: Tummy Tuck Surgery (Abdominoplasty)

  • Mommy Makeover Surgery

    "Mommy makeover" is a planning term for selected cosmetic surgeries that address changes after pregnancy, breastfeeding and weight fluctuation.

    Explore: Mommy Makeover Surgery

Post-Pregnancy & Post-Weight-Loss Planning

Planning for loose skin, residual fat and abdominal changes once weight is stable.

  • Post-Pregnancy Belly Correction

    Pregnancy can change the abdomen through localised fat, looser skin and abdominal-wall changes, often all at once.

    Explore: Post-Pregnancy Belly Correction

  • Post-Weight Loss Body Planning

    After substantial weight loss, the scale may no longer be the main concern. Loose skin, uneven contour, residual localised fat and changes in tissue quality can affect different body areas differently.

    Explore: Post-Weight Loss Body Planning

  • Post-Weight Loss Loose Skin Treatment

    After substantial weight loss, stretched skin may not fully contract to the new body size.

    Explore: Post-Weight Loss Loose Skin Treatment

Stretch Marks, Cellulite & Skin Quality

Texture and laxity concerns that are separate from fat or weight.

  • Stretch Mark Treatment

    Stretch marks are changes within the skin that can develop after growth, pregnancy, weight change or other periods of rapid stretching.

    Explore: Stretch Mark Treatment

  • Skin Tightening Treatment

    Skin laxity can follow weight change, ageing or changes in tissue support, and it is not the same problem as localised fat.

    Explore: Skin Tightening Treatment

  • Cellulite Reduction

    Cellulite is a textural contour issue characterised by dimpling or uneven skin and can occur regardless of body weight.

    Explore: Cellulite Reduction

  • Anti-Cellulite Therapy

    Cellulite causes dimpling and uneven texture, even in people at a healthy, stable weight. NeoSculpt6 treats it as a skin and tissue contour concern, not simply excess fat.

    Explore: Anti-Cellulite Therapy

Your Assessment

From Health History to Follow-Up

Your health, medicines, past weight-management efforts, pregnancies and any eating concerns.

The areas that concern you, skin quality and, where useful, body-composition analysis.

What you would like to change, and whether that is overall weight, a specific area or skin.

Whether medical, non-surgical or surgical care suits you now, and when it does not.

The suitable approaches, what each can and cannot change, and how they may combine.

Side effects, downtime and monitoring for the option you are considering.

Regular reviews of progress and safety; change is gradual and differs between people.

    Quick Answers

    Slimming & Body Contouring FAQs

    No. Body contouring treats selected areas of localised fat or skin in people near a stable weight. Overall weight is managed medically, and the consultation explains which kind of care suits your concern.

    These are prescription medicines. Whether one is suitable is a medical decision made after reviewing your health, other medicines and history, with monitoring and follow-up. They are not suitable for everyone.

    Change varies with the treatment, your body and your habits, so no fixed amount of weight or inches is promised. Your doctor explains realistic expectations for the option you are considering.

    Surgery may be discussed when loose skin, abdominal-wall changes or larger areas of fat are beyond what non-surgical care can address, and once weight is stable. A plastic surgeon assesses suitability.

    Timing depends on your recovery, whether you are breastfeeding and how stable your weight is. The consultation helps decide when an assessment or treatment is appropriate.

    Cost depends on your assessment, the approach, the areas treated, the number of sessions or programme length, and follow-up, so it is explained after your consultation rather than quoted in advance.
